s0DB73F.name: Diagonal pipe, diagonal ledges, switch blocks
summary: Level object draw routines (standard objects, Map16 tile writers). $57 = position index into the level Map16 buffer, [$59] = size byte (width/height nibbles).
CODE_0DB73F: right-facing diagonal pipe (rows grow two tiles wider, drawn down-left, tiles from DATA_0DB72F, bottom cap $1EB).
CODE_0DB7AA / CODE_0DB863: left- and right-facing diagonal ledges (slope, slope assist, dirt and diagonal-line tiles, picked by CODE_0DB84E / CODE_0DABFD depending on the tile underneath).
CODE_0DB916 / CODE_0DB91E: blue / red switch blocks (solid tile $06C/$06D until the switch palace switch is pressed, then $16C/$16D).
Tile numbers: Map16 page 1 ($1xx) is set with Sta1To6ePointer, page 0 with StzTo6ePointer. Includes the helper CODE_0DB84E.

s0DB962.name: Tile table: small tree trunk
summary: Top tiles $0BD/$0BF and bottom tiles $0BE/$0C0 by trunk type.

s0DB966.name: Forest tree trunks and ledge
summary: CODE_0DB966: small tree trunk (type 0/1, 16x32 repeating, tile merging via CODE_0DB997).
CODE_0DB9C0: large tree trunk ($0B9/$0BA, $0BB/$0BC rows; $10B/$10C when starting on a ledge top).
CODE_0DBA0A: forest ledge (top row of $10E then rows of $0B8).

s0DBA44.name: Tile table: forest left/right/top edge
summary: Top tiles $5F,$5E,$10,$0F and bottom tiles $60,$5D,$C5,$C4 by edge type.

s0DBA4C.name: Forest left/right and top edge object
summary: Draws a vertical column: a top tile (DATA_0DBA44+type) and then lower tiles (DATA_0DBA48+type) for the given height.
Parameters: [$59] low nibble = edge type (0-3), high nibble = height.

s0DBA7C.name: Data: forest tree top canopy
summary: 16x6 tile pattern, one 16-byte row per line. $B4 = leaves, $B1/$B3/$B5/$B6 = edge pieces, $25 = blank.

s0DBADC.name: Forest tree top and ice blue pipe
summary: CODE_0DBADC: forest tree top. Copies the 16x6 canopy table once per screen, moving +$1B0 (next screen) between copies. Parameters: [$59] = number of extra screens.
CODE_0DBB2C: ice blue vertical pipe ($161/$162 top, $163/$164 middle rows). Parameters: [$59] high nibble = middle rows.
CODE_0DBB63: ice blue turn tiles, reuses the generic block routine CODE_0DA8C3 with X = $0E.

s0DBB68.name: Castle tileset Map16 tile definitions
summary: Starts with $FF freespace up to $0DBBFF. From $0DBC00 are the tileset-specific Map16 definitions used by tileset 1 (castle, TilesetMAP16Loc),
8 bytes per tile = 4 x (chr, prop) in order TL, BL, TR, BR (left column first; verified against flipped-pair rows). prop = YXPCCCTT.
Tile numbers are those where the Map16 load mask (DATA_0581BB) uses tileset-specific data: $073-$0FF, $107-$110, $153-$16D. All-zero rows are unused tiles.

s0DC190.name: Castle tileset object dispatch
summary: Called for standard objects when the tileset is 1 (castle). Calls the draw routine for object [$5A] through the long-pointer table that follows.

summary: Three rows of two tiles: $098,$099 / $09A,$09B / $09C,$09C.

s0DC31E.name: Boss door object

PtrsLong0DC34A.name: Conveyor objects (left and right)
summary: CODE_0DC341 picks left or right (bit 1 of [$59]); the table at $0DC34A holds the two routines.
CODE_0DC358 (left) and CODE_0DC3D8 (right) draw a triangular conveyor-topped slope: conveyor tile ($1CE-$1D1), slope assist tile ($1F3-$1F6) and dirt ($03F), one row wider per step.
Parameters: [$59] high nibble = rows - 1, low 2 bits = conveyor type.
